map.传动比 i = z2/z1；链速 v = z1·p·n1/60000（m/s，p: Ratio i = z2/z1; chain speed v = z1·p·n1/60000 (m/s, p is the pitch in mm); n2 = n1/i; number of links Lp = 2a0/p + (z1+z2)/2 + [(z2−z1)/(2π)]²·p/a0, result taken as even; small sprocket wrap angle α1 ≈ 180° − 57.3·(d2−d1)/a0 (d = p/sin(π/z) is the sprocket pitch circle diameter); sprocket pitch circle d = p/sin(π/z); tight-side tension F = P×1000/v (N). Recommended chain speed ≤15 m/s.

map.链节数为什么要取偶？: Why must the number of links be even?
map.链条由内、外链节交替组成，必须用偶数节链条配一个连接链节才能闭合；奇数节需额外的: A chain consists of alternating inner and outer link plates, so an even-link chain needs a connecting link to close; an odd number of links requires an extra transition link whose strength is markedly lower than ordinary links, so it should be avoided in design.
map.链速过高有什么问题？: What problems does excessive chain speed cause?
map.链速过高会加剧冲击与噪声、加速铰链磨损，并因『多边形效应』引起速度波动；普通滚子: Excessive chain speed aggravates impact and noise, accelerates hinge wear, and causes speed fluctuation through the polygon effect; for ordinary roller chains v ≤ 15 m/s is recommended, and high-speed applications should use small-pitch, high-tooth-count chains or inverted tooth chains with enhanced lubrication.
